videos.headline: Providence puts game away as Noah Locke drills big 3
videos.description: The Friars win a scramble for the loose ball, and Noah Locke connects from deep to help Providence upset No. 4 UConn.

videos.headline: UConn's Donovan Clingan left alone for thunderous throwdown
videos.description: UConn freshmen link up as Alex Karaban sends a pinpoint pass to Donovan Clingan for a two-handed slam.

videos.headline: Corey Floyd buries 3 to beat shot clock for Providence
videos.description: Providence takes a five-point lead as Corey Floyd Jr. connects from beyond the arc for the Friars.

videos.headline: Andre Jackson throws down vicious and-1 jam for UConn
videos.description: UConn's Andre Jackson attacks the rim for a powerful dunk despite being fouled.

videos.headline: Ed Croswell glides in for a Providence dunk
videos.description: Providence gets out in transition and Jayden Pierre feeds Ed Croswell for a two-handed slam.

videos.headline: Providence's Devin Carter drills contested triple
videos.description: Devin Carter hits an off-balance 3-pointer for Providence with the shot clock winding down.
